statement: A fixture README is part of its test contract: when it says a placeholder-only environment file is the reproduction but the test only writes non-placeholder values and asserts the ordinary path finding, reviewers are invited to validate behavior the suite never exercises. State exactly which fixture values and outcomes the assertions cover, or add the missing control before claiming it is characterized. A green test run validates code, not a prose description that names a different case.

movesWhen.reason: The corrected PR lands and the staged lesson is harvested by the operator-run process.
